identity.title: Native receipt validator has an impossible artifact-role denominator

values.summary: Strengthen the validator's explicit role-set and post-proof path policies, add focused negative and positive regression checks, then review the exact delta.

steps.action: Implement explicit canonical role-set and verifier-only Git path policy helpers
Prove positive and negative policy cases in a temporary Git repository

invariants: Platform coverage remains exact and unique
No runtime or product path is verifier-only
risks: An overbroad allowlist could accept stale product proof
Set canonicalization could accidentally hide duplicate roles
stop_conditions: The repair requires any Runtime v3 product change
The WP-03 committed validator baseline changes during implementation
